description: Replaces a 'with open(path) as f' context manager with a bare open() call that is never closed, inside a per-item loop.

findings.summary: File handle opened per loop iteration is never closed, leaking descriptors for large path lists
findings.evidence: 'with open(path) as f' was replaced by 'f = open(path)' with no matching close() or context manager; each iteration of the paths loop leaks one open file descriptor.
